summary: Pure refactor. userMade in src/table/hand-record.ts is now exported with an unchanged body (same seat/blind filter as the old inline condition). handCategoryDecisions in src/stats/leaks.ts pairs records by reference against userMade(hand.actions, userSeat), which is linear in actions. positionGroup runs at most once per hand and is now lazy, so a hand with no preflop pairing no longer calls it or throws. Stored hand data (records parsed from storage or import) reaches the same reads as before. No new sinks (DOM, eval, network, storage writes), no new dependencies, no secrets, no randomness. Resource use per hand is the same or lower. Reference pairing can't be spoofed: every record in made is an element of hand.actions, and parsed JSON produces distinct objects. No security findings.
